checks.detail: Both host receipts bind the frozen candidate (74fe45da..., candidate_id loop-14-74fe45da5118); all blocking checks pass and the two independent runs render identical baseline/today/inbox/projects frames. Verified at runtime and in source: auth shell with typed field-level validation (webdriver-w3c, trusted), signed-in shell with Today/Inbox/Projects/Calendar/Focus/Settings and sign-out, Inbox search + priority/due/completion filters backed by the parameterized query_tasks command with priority settable on rows, Projects board with Planned/In progress/Done columns, drag-and-drop plus keyboard column select, single-authority set_task_status, archive/restore with archived projects excluded from active lists, subtask + append-only activity-history model behind a v4 lossless migration, calendar month+agenda, focus session history, reminder delivery states. This independently closes the three fixed_pending_verify product issues (subtask/activity, inbox filters, board/archive). Risk-handoff checked: the host did execute focusboard-verify capture_evidence against the candidate (unlike the developer's local report), so the replay+verify lanes ran; only external_deeplink stayed not_run (host-pinned). Verdict fails on the remaining PRD-required gap: Settings still lacks password change, session management, and account-deletion request (PRD 8), and the release-critical section-3 external journey plus external focusboard:// activation remain receipt-unproven (renderer self-drive only, untrusted authority; warm=0/cold=0).
